- The landing page would also need to make any claim in the ad. "Recommended by nutritionists" isn't something we can back up, so it can't be there.
- No slop-list words, exclamation marks, or rhetorical openers.
- Character counts: you didn't give limits, so I haven't checked against any. Headline is 21 characters. The description is 80 characters including the nutritionists line, 56 without it.

Remove the nutritionist line. If you do have a source (a named nutritionist, a survey, written permission), supply it and I'll add it back. Otherwise, a compliant replacement from the allowlist:

- Headline: Plastic-Free Tea Bags
- Description: Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Free UK delivery over £25.
